faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Have questions about account setup, document verification, or payments? Find quick answers below.

items.question: How do I create an account?
items.answer: Visit e-renty.com, click Sign In, then choose to register. Enter your name, email and a password of at least 8 characters. We'll send a 6-digit verification code to your inbox — enter it to activate your account.

items.question: What documents do I need to rent?
items.answer: All customers must pass identity verification before renting. You need to upload an ID card or residence permit, a selfie, a proof-of-address card, and a business registration certificate. Each document is reviewed individually and you'll be notified once approved.

items.question: What payment methods are accepted?
items.answer: We accept Visa/Mastercard, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and bank transfer. Card and wallet payments are processed securely through Stripe — your card details are never stored on our servers.

items.question: Can I pay monthly instead of upfront?
items.answer: Yes. At checkout you choose Monthly (only the first month is charged now, future months appear in your Payments tab with due dates) or Upfront (pay the full period at a discounted rate shown live in the checkout summary).

items.question: What is the minimum rental period?
items.answer: The platform minimum is typically 3 months, though this can vary. The checkout flow clearly shows the minimum — period buttons below it are greyed out and not selectable.
